title: Admin Driver
description:
PNG Air, renowned for its extensive network covering over 26 destinations throughout Papua New Guinea, operates the largest fleet of ATR 72-600 series aircraft in the region. As the Airline of Choice, we're committed to delivering a world-class experience with competitive fares, unparalleled cargo rates, and a focus on safety and on-time performance for our valued customers and stakeholders.
ADMIN DRIVER
Facilities and Ground Services is seeking for an experienced candidate for the position of Admin Driver based in Port Moresby, operationally reporting to General Manager Operations.
This role is responsible to the GM Operations in carrying out driving duties as required from time to time;
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Drive office vehicles, transporting authorized personnel, do delivery and collection of mailed documents and other items as required.
Collect and deliver mail and other communications off/from the Company
Maintain assigned vehicles; renew road licenses and vehicle insurance when required.
Perform minor repairs and ensure that the vehicle is kept clean.
Check the logging of official trips, daily mileages, fuel consumption, oil changes etc. in the log books
Ensure that in the event of an accident, the Company rules and regulations are adhered
Perform other admin duties such as delegated by the Finance & Admin Manager from time to time.
QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCES
Minimum Grade 12 qualification
Must have a valid class 3-6 PNG Driver’s License
Minimum of three (3) years driving experience
Appropriate work experience in a similar role
Have no criminal records or no prior criminal/traffic offenses. Current Police Clearance is required.
Must be customer service orientated, physically fit with quick learning skills
Excellent communication skills
If you feel you meet our requirements and are interested, we would like to hear from you. Send your application in only one PDF file to:
[email protected]
Applications close:
Friday 07th November 2025
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
We are an equal opportunity employer.
